subject: Mutual plan draft — stakeholder roles, dependencies & target close
messages:
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Klein <jordan@cloudretail.com>, Emily Park <emily.park@cloudretail.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Mar 2026 08:10:00 -07:00
Subject: Post-call: mutual plan (draft) + stakeholder roles

Thanks for the time today — quick recap and next steps attached. I pulled together a one-page Mutual Action Plan (attached) that captures the milestones we discussed, owners, and the tight dependencies around procurement + SOC evidence. High-level: 

- Goal: production pilot (1M-10M monthly requests) by end of Q2 (target close: 2026-06-30)
- Key milestones: 1) PO & contract signed, 2) Private deployment kickoff (VPC), 3) Security review complete (SOC2 evidence), 4) Pilot run + performance sign-off
- Immediate ask: can you confirm economic buyer and legal owner so we can finalize the commercial milestone?

I've marked proposed internal owners from our side and annotated items where we need your input. Attached: CloudRetail_MAP_v1.xlsx (MAP), Redwood_SOC2_Summary.pdf (SOC2 snapshot).

Next steps I propose: 
1) You confirm stakeholder RACI edits by Mon 3/23
2) Redwood to incorporate legal/commercial redlines once we have legal contact
3) Procurement looped for PO template and timing

Marissa (cc) flagged a technical dependency on network ACLs for Private deployment — Marissa, do you mind writing a one-paragraph note on the network prerequisites we should expect?

Jordan/Emily — feel free to edit the attached MAP directly in Drive (link below) or reply with inline changes. I’ll circulate a v2 on Tue.

Drive link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1A2bCloudRetailMAP

Thanks,
Rishi Malhotra
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
rishi.malhotra@redwood.com

Date: Fri, 20 Mar 2026 11:37:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Post-call: mutual plan (draft) + stakeholder roles

Thanks Rishi — appreciate the clear MAP. A few quick clarifications from our side: 

1) Economic buyer: that’ll be me for commercial approval, but final sign-off moves to our CFO (Ana Ramirez) for PO amounts > $250k — I’ll keep you posted if we hit that threshold.
2) Legal owner: I don’t own legal here. Our legal lead for platform agreements is Thomas Nguyen (thomas.nguyen@cloudretail.com). Please loop him when you have an initial contract/term sheet.
3) Security owner: Emily will be the point for security/compliance (cc’d) — Emily, can you confirm the SOC2 evidence is sufficient and any gaps we should flag?

Also, target close: we’re optimistic about a late-June close but procurement timelines may push that; can we set a working target of 2026-06-30 and treat it as tentative?

I made two small edits in the MAP (column: target_test_scope, row: pilot) — saved in Drive.

Jordan
VP Product | CloudRetail
jordan@cloudretail.com

Subject: Re: Post-call: mutual plan (draft) + stakeholder roles

Quick technical note on the Private deployment prerequisites (per Rishi’s ask):

- Network: customer to provide a dedicated VPC with two subnets (private + management). BGP not required; static routing acceptable.
- Firewall/ACLs: allow outbound TLS 443 to Redwood control plane (redwood-control.redwood.com) + NTP.
- Data flow: model inference occurs on nodes in your VPC; logs/metrics are optionally routed to your SIEM via syslog endpoint.
- Estimated bootstrap time: 2-3 business days once infra access + KMS keys are provided.

I’ll add these to the MAP under "Technical Dependencies" and flag the items that will block kickoff. Happy to jump on a quick call with your infra team if needed.

—Marissa
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com

Date: Tue, 24 Mar 2026 10:22:00 -07:00
Subject: MAP v2 — RACI updates + action items (please confirm)

Jordan/Thomas/Emily — thanks for the rapid feedback. I’ve incorporated Jordan’s commercial notes and Marissa’s technical bullets into MAP v2 (see Drive). Below is the updated RACI snapshot I’m proposing — please confirm or suggest alternatives: 

RACI (proposed):
- Economic Buyer: Responsible = Jordan Klein (CloudRetail); Accountable = Ana Ramirez (CFO, CloudRetail); Consulted = Rishi Malhotra (Redwood); Informed = Sales Ops
- Security Owner: Responsible = Emily Park (CloudRetail); Accountable = Thomas Nguyen (Legal, CloudRetail) — *note: Thomas, please confirm you’re comfortable being listed as accountable for legal/security sign-off*
- Legal Owner: Responsible = Thomas Nguyen (CloudRetail Legal); Accountable = Ana Ramirez (CloudRetail CFO); Consulted = Laura Bennett (Redwood Legal)
- Eng Lead (Pilot): Responsible = Emily Park (CloudRetail); Accountable = Marissa Cole (Redwood SE)

Open items for CloudRetail: 
1) Confirm legal owner + preferred PO template (procurement email).
2) Confirm target close date (working target 2026-06-30).
3) Share any additional security evidence beyond SOC2 (e.g., pen test, architecture diagram) if needed.

Action items on our side: 
- LAURA: I’ve asked our legal lead (Laura Bennett) to standby for a first-pass on the contract when Thomas shares preferred terms.
- KARTHIK: will prepare commercial term sheet and margin overlay for Ana if needed.
- MARISSA: will prepare the infra checklist and internal-runbook for pilot.

Thomas/Jordan — can you reply to confirm the RACI roles and whether June 30 remains an acceptable working target? If confirmed, we’ll lock milestones in MAP v2 and push procurement tasks to week of 3/29.

Regards,
Rishi Malhotra
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
